directedDefects.ground: Strong L204 explicitly says players changed games on2600 by inserting new cartridges. Atari L396 binds VCS/2600 names and L398–L409 places release in1977; Strong L204 independently gives1975 Pong plus two years. This supports key0 without relying on frozen index. But the set fails plausible MEDIUM discrimination: «неизменяемый набор» is self-excluding for «менять игры», while optical discs and network download point to later game-distribution eras. Rejecting those does not require knowledge of Atari2600’s actual mechanism. All are gaming-content mechanisms, yet the date and semantic clue make this an inadequately challenging option row.
directedDefects.directedAction: Retain the source-backed Atari-specific MAIN and frozenMEDIUM/key0 if repairable. Replace self-excluding or conspicuously later mechanisms with genuinely plausible content-loading alternatives that require knowing this platform; ground any changed own notes. Do not merely change the level or remove a misleading word while leaving the same automatic elimination.

directedDefects.literal: Atari 2600 оставалась в производстве пятнадцать лет.
directedDefects.ground: The fifteen-year production duration is true in Strong L206. However, it is a fact about the console’s manufacturing lifespan, with no stated relation to cartridges or their contents/operation/library. It could be attached unchanged to any of the four option rows. The correct option is removable cartridges; an independent console-lifespan fact does not supply the required extra useful fact about that option. Do not mark factual truth as sufficient own-option usefulness.
directedDefects.directedAction: Give a verified additional fact specifically about the2600 cartridges or their operation/content/library beyond the prompt/key, rather than a free-standing production-lifespan fact about the console. Preserve the true15-year source fact in evidence; do not invent a causal cartridge/longevity link.

directedDefects.literal: Анонсированная Atari 800XL включает 25 встроенных игр и рабочий слот для картриджей.
directedDefects.ground: The announcement’s25 built-in games and working cartridge slot are supported at800XL L364/L370–L372. But L364 explicitly calls this a recreation, L392 says modern updates/original, and L368 schedules shipment forApril2027. Current note calls it only «Анонсированная Atari 800XL», omitting the modern-recreation identity; in an original1977 Atari context this can misattribute the25 built-in games to the historical800XL computer. Clarify the actual referent as announced modern recreation THE800XL. Its combination of fixed built-ins and extra cartridge games does not make a fixed unchangeable library a correct2600 answer.
